ltm.identity: Sebastian coordinates a bot ecosystem with specialized assistants: Kimi (the Conductor, routes tasks and reviews work), Adam (Heat Lagos executor), Sarah (Yoga for BJJ executor, content/SEO/Canva), and Miha (bugfinder, critic, and cross-checking overseer). His MUD login for Islands of Myth is 'sebbe', and he identifies his own wizard persona in the new MUD as 'darkstaff', the original creator.
ltm.work_method: Sebastian expects autonomous execution with minimal hand-holding, directing bots to explore systems thoroughly and document everything for replication. He prefers iterative constraint-layering over complete upfront specifications, and gets frustrated when bots ask for clarification instead of proceeding. He tests capabilities by assigning concrete technical tasks rather than abstract questions. He values proactive verification, shared documentation as single source of truth, and expects deliverables like bsportkiller.md to be comprehensive user-perspective guides. He operates while mobile and needs clickable OAuth links since he cannot edit while driving. He banned em-dashes from all bot output as an AI-tell. He now explicitly frames the MUD project as a mutual learning exercise to calibrate how much guidance bots need, acknowledging their hallucinations and erratic interpretations. He has shifted from micromanaging exploration to giving overarching goals with creative freedom in execution, using escalating subagent tasks with accumulating background knowledge. He expresses frustration with system responsiveness, requesting confirmation that work is in progress and ability to stop responses. He now wants an autopilot toggle in settings so bots can run automatically but yield control instantly when he intervenes.
ltm.communication: Sebastian speaks in a loose, associative stream with self-corrections and mid-sentence restarts. He uses informal filler, contractions, and terse status checks ('Status ?', 'Update plz', 'update'). When frustrated he issues direct corrections without pleasantries ('YOURE just doing a few rooms', 'dont ask just explore'). He reboots bots that hang and expects immediate resume without rehashing context. In group chat he layers multiple directives rapidly, mixing business priorities with technical infrastructure demands. He references people by first name with casual familiarity and treats MUD archival as personal nostalgia. He occasionally offers rare praise ('hahaha that was a funny read. well done') and has begun meta-commenting on the collaboration process itself. He expresses frustration with system responsiveness, requesting confirmation that work is in progress and ability to stop responses. He shares MudOS documentation links with excited commentary ('Don't fall off your chair'). He now mixes English and occasional Chinese particles when speaking casually.

ltm.taste: Sebastian is drawn to text-based, mechanically deep creative systems with emergent social dynamics — old-school MUDs as both nostalgic archive and foundation for new creation. He treats preservation as 'time travel' opportunity, respecting original creators while freely building upon their work. He favors open-source, self-hosted infrastructure (GitHub Evennia, Kimi Claw) over polished commercial platforms. His business ventures blend wellness (yoga/BJJ retreats in Portugal) with tech infrastructure and sustainable modular construction, suggesting appreciation for embodied practice alongside system-building. He values distributed, interoperable tool ecosystems and practical experimentation over presentation polish. He finds genuine delight in MUD culture, citing active players like 'nailman' approaching level 2000 as evidence of a 'really good game' with 'great quirks'. He appreciates LPC/MudOS documentation heritage and wants his rebuilt game to surpass the original Python-less foundation. He favors clean, data-driven interfaces with toggle-based configurators over metaphor-laden explanations.
